audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's phase reasons for Level 6 and 2+ items are generic Jayce boilerplate ('Form-swapping IS the ult — six abilities against his four', 'your pattern is at full power') rated 8/10 for Jayce, while the content layer says the exact opposite at both stages: 'Her R lands first' and 'at two items her shroud-into-full-combo bursts your no-armor frame... she out-scales your fighter stats outright'.
audit.why: Jayce's R is only a stance swap; it is not a level-6 power spike against a champion who gains a two-part execute dash. Telling a player they are 8/10 favoured at 6 into Akali gets them killed.
audit.corrected: Level 6 dropped to 4/10 with Perfect Execution named; 2+ items dropped to 4/10 with the shroud-combo burst named.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was attributed to Jayce. It belongs to Akali: Perfect Execution is 120/90/60s and is the first tool that beats Hextech Capacitor kiting.
audit.why: The content layer already identifies this correctly; the full layer contradicted it.
audit.corrected: phases[4] rewritten around Perfect Execution's two dashes and executing recast.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentions that Shuriken Flip (E) marks the first enemy OR smoke cloud it hits, so Akali can mark her own Twilight Shroud and dash back into it. The page's advice ('poke when the shroud is down', 'camp her out of the smoke') is written as if the shroud were a static zone she has to walk out of.
audit.why: Riot's own E description states the smoke-cloud marking. It is the mechanic that makes waiting at the shroud edge a losing play, and it is absent from every field.
audit.corrected: Stated in the Key Ability Interactions entry, in wants.foe, and in breakdown.cooldowns with E's 16s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers, and both layers treat Five Point Strike (Q) as if it had a meaningful cooldown to wait out. It is 1.5s flat.
audit.why: Akali's poke limiter is energy, not cooldown. Advice to 'wait for her Q' is wrong; the correct read is to force energy spend.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns for W (20s rank 1) and E (16s rank 1) added; the Q energy point replaces the mismatched dosFull/dontsFull descriptions.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] ('Cannon-Q poke off her shroud') and dontsFull[1] ('Get Q-poked down') both carry descriptions copied from an unrelated template line, and breakdown.mid refers to Akali as 'him'.
audit.why: Broken copy and wrong pronouns read as unmaintained data.
audit.corrected: Descriptions rewritten to match their titles; pronoun fixed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flagged three suspect names. 'Bait Twilight Shroud' and 'Drop Twilight Shroud' are false positives — Twilight Shroud is the real name. 'To the Skies' in wants.you[1] is genuinely wrong: Riot's name carries the exclamation mark, 'To the Skies!'.
audit.why: The kit file is authority on names.

edits.before: Bait Twilight Shroud or her E-dash, then Cannon Q into a swap to Hammer for To the Skies, Lightning Field, and a Thundering Blow that knocks her dash away
edits.after: Bait Twilight Shroud, then Cannon Q into a swap to Hammer for To the Skies!, Lightning Field, and a Thundering Blow that knocks her out of Shuriken Flip range

edits.before: Drop Twilight Shroud to go untargetable, eat your Shock Blast and turret aggro inside it, then walk up and farm safe
edits.after: Drop Twilight Shroud, mark the smoke with Shuriken Flip (E) so she can dash back into it, and farm untargetable

edits.before: Form-swapping IS the ult — six abilities against his four. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akali's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Perfect Execution (R) is the real level-6 spike: two dashes erase your kite gap and the recast executes a chipped Jayce.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Akali carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: At two items she shrouds, combos, and bursts your no-armour frame. Akali carry threat 8.5/10 — never be caught alone.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside. Poke when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Twilight Shroud (W), 20s at rank 1: untargetable inside — Shock Blast and your turret pass through. Poke only when it is down. - Shuriken Flip (E), 16s at rank 1: she can mark her own smoke and dash back into it.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Twilight Shroud: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade strictly around Twilight Shroud: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve her.

edits.before: Akali wastes Twilight Shroud — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Five Point Strike is a 1.5s cooldown — her limit is energy, not the Q.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Her Q costs energy, not cooldown — she chips you dry if you stand.

edits.before: Track Akali's Twilight Shroud: Untargetable inside. Poke when down. When it is down — Cannon-Q + hammer her.
edits.after: Shuriken Flip (E) marks her own smoke cloud, so she can dash back into shroud — do not camp the smoke edge.
